summary: Capcom's dinosaur survival-horror/action branch; use the modern PC rereleases for the first two games, and original hardware or emulation for the PS2 light-gun, mobile, and Xbox-only entries.

entries.title: Dino Crisis

emulation.emulator: None for modern PC; DuckStation/Redream fallback
emulation.notes: DuckStation is useful for the original PlayStation version; Redream can preserve the Dreamcast port.

primary.why: The modern PC rerelease supports Windows 10/11, 4K resolution, and modern gamepads, while preserving the PC version's bonus/accessibility advantages over the original console releases.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GOG or Steam PC release on a modern Windows PC; use PlayStation Classics on PS4/PS5 if you prefer the original console version.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically central, but lower fidelity than modern PC and PS4/PS5 classic routes.
skip: alternate console port with no sourced exclusive story content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC port with bonuses such as Operation Wipe Out and mode/costume availability.
all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for modern compatibility by the 2025/2026 PC rerelease.
skip: convenient legacy PlayStation access, but lower fidelity than modern PC and PS4/PS5 routes.

all_releases.fidelity: PlayStation Classics release of the original PlayStation game.
all_releases.reason: skip: best console route, but modern PC has the highest fidelity ceiling.

all_releases.fidelity: GOG/Steam rerelease with Windows 10/11 support, 4K resolution, and modern gamepad support.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most convenient modern route for the first game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PS4/PS5 is the best official route for the original PlayStation version, while modern PC is the fidelity and convenience pick; use PlayStation only if original-console presentation matters.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern PC rerelease enhances compatibility/fidelity but is not a remake.

entries.title: Dino Crisis 2

emulation.emulator: None for modern PC; DuckStation fallback
emulation.notes: DuckStation is useful for original PlayStation comparison.

primary.why: The modern PC rerelease supports Windows 10/11, 4K resolution, and modern gamepads, making it the highest-fidelity current route for the sequel.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GOG or Steam PC release on a modern Windows PC; use DuckStation only for original PlayStation comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: original reference version, but modern PC has the highest fidelity and compatibility ceiling.
skip: superseded by the 2025/2026 PC rerelease for modern compatibility.

all_releases.fidelity: GOG/Steam rerelease with Windows 10/11 support, 4K resolution, and modern gamepad support.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current fidelity and access route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Modern PC rerelease is the recommended current route; no exclusive PlayStation content is known to be absent from it.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern PC rerelease enhances compatibility/fidelity but is not a remake.

emulation.notes: Use original hardware for intended light-gun play; emulator route is mainly archival.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PS2 with GunCon authenticity or high-resolution PS2 emulation

primary.why: Dino Stalker is a PS2-only light-gun spin-off tied to Dino Crisis 2; original hardware with GunCon 2 best preserves its intended control scheme.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS2 hardware with GunCon 2 where possible; use PCSX2 only for archival/controller-based play.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 light-gun shooter with optional GunCon support.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented platform route and best control authenticity with GunCon hardware.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PCSX2 can improve image quality, but original PS2 hardware better preserves the light-gun design.

primary.why: Dungeon in Chaos is a first-person shooter mobile spin-off published by Mobile Capcom in 2003; no modern port is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Treat as an archival Japanese mobile release; no current official modern purchase/play route is documented.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Mobile Capcom first-person shooter spin-off.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Released mobile title, but current availability/preservation route is unclear.

emulation.notes: Use original Xbox hardware if emulation compatibility is not sufficient.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox / emulator scaling where compatible

primary.platform: Xbox via original hardware or xemu
primary.why: Dino Crisis 3 is an Xbox-only sequel; original hardware or Xbox emulation is the only documented route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware, or try xemu if compatibility is acceptable; no modern port is documented.

all_releases.reason: primary: only documented released platform; the planned PS2 version was scrapped.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Single released platform; planned PS2 version was not released.

entries.title: Dino Crisis Bundle

primary.why: The 2025 bundle packages the modern PC rereleases of Dino Crisis and Dino Crisis 2, making it the best purchase route if both games are desired together.
primary.how_to_play: Buy/play the bundle on GOG, then follow the individual Dino Crisis and Dino Crisis 2 PC routes for each game.

all_releases.fidelity: Compilation of the modern PC rereleases of Dino Crisis and Dino Crisis 2.
all_releases.reason: primary: only documented compilation route and best bundle access for the first two games together.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Compilation contains the first two modern PC rereleases; no separate story content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Compilation product, not a new game or remake.
